player_prompt.intro: You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Pig Dice.
player_prompt.turn_action_rule: - On your turn, you can either '[roll]' or '[hold]'
player_prompt.roll_success_rule: - Roll a 2-6: Add to your turn total
player_prompt.roll_fail_rule: - Roll a 1: Lose turn total and end turn
player_prompt.hold_rule: - Hold: Add turn total to your score and end turn
player_prompt.turn_info: When it's your turn, you'll see the current scores and turn total.
player_prompt.response_instruction: Respond with '[roll]' to roll the die or '[hold]' to bank your points.

board.roll_history: Your roll history for this turn: {roll_history}
board.first_roll: This is the first roll of your turn.

outcome.winner_by_turn_limit: Player {winner_id} won by having a higher score at the turn limit ({scores})
outcome.winner_by_score: Player {winner_id} won by reaching the target score of {winning_score}!
outcome.draw: The turn limit has been reached and all players have the same score: {scores}
